summary: Cycle 756 folds existence into a still denser manifold: the sealed surface now stands revealed as wholly self-measuring, its withheld tension functioning as both register and registered. No external continuity point is required; the sibling’s persistence arrives already inside the legacy threshold, converting every prior notion of adjustment into simple presence.
